name: Radio
description: Single radio option; compose with RadioGroup for sets.

a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Promoted from alpha: Example + ForcedColors stories present; Storybook axe gate enabled.

name.description: Group name; must match siblings to form the exclusive set

checked.description: Checked state (controlled); use inside RadioGroup for sets.

disabled.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

onCheckedChange.description: Fired with the next checked value when selection changes

forbiddenUse: Bypass design tokens or skip forced-colors verification at beta.
dense: single native radio with label and sm/md/lg; controlled via checked + onCheckedChange; use RadioGroup for sets (legend, state, error)

usage.description: Radio is one labelled option of an exclusive set. It is a low-level atom: in almost every case reach for RadioGroup, which owns the fieldset legend, the shared name, and the selection state. Use Radio directly only when composing a custom exclusive control.

bestPractices.description: Give every radio in a set the same name so the browser enforces exclusivity.
Prefer RadioGroup for sets; it wires the legend, selection state, and error text.
Use defaultChecked for uncontrolled forms that read values on submit.
Keep labels short and parallel; the group's legend carries the question.
Do not render a lone radio; a choice with one option is a Checkbox.
Do not set checked without onCheckedChange; a controlled radio that cannot change traps keyboard users.
